description: A VS Code extension that converts colors between hex, rgb, rgba, hsl and hsla.
command.colorConversion.title: Color Conversion
configuration.title: Color Conversion
configuration.defaultFormat.description: Target format used by the Color Conversion command. "ask" always shows a quick pick.
configuration.defaultFormat.ask: Always ask with a quick pick
configuration.spacing.description: Add a space after the commas of rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() output, for example rgb(255, 0, 0).
configuration.hexCase.description: Letter case used for hex output.
configuration.hexCase.preserve: Preserve the letter case of the original hex value
